name: Bastion
_: Region 2's boss (S5-5, feat/boss-region-2; the owner's design of 2026-10-14, his choice of 2026-10-15: N-C with W2), drawn by scripts/boss-r2-art.mjs. The hangar at the centre (a one-cell cap, the core under it, the doors under the core; the escort launches from the doors), a laser cannon each side hugging it, a sliding rail of three guns outside each cannon. A rail-gun kill slides its rail one pitch inward; the second slide covers that side's cannon - invulnerable, still firing - and the rail stops (it never reaches the hangar). The doors are locked (barred armour, band.png) until every cannon and rail gun is destroyed or covered, then open (amber chevrons, open.png) with a flash and a sound; the core, a salvo launcher, falls last.

palette._: COLPF0 pale steel, COLPF1 mid steel, COLPF2 hazard amber (lights, the core, the opened doors' chevrons; hue 34, 168 degrees from the ally steel $88 of levels 4-6), COLPF3 the olive bulk (the track, the locked doors; hue 82, 144 degrees).

motion._: Still at position 32: the rails' slides are the only motion (the owner's rule: no mishmash of motions).

escort._: Region 1's cadence (decision AI); the escort launches from the doors (entry 124: the doors' column) and stops when they fall (the block's code).

rails._: The sliding rails (src/hybrid/boss.s BOSS_RAIL): a kill of a rail's front gun slides the rail one pitch inward after delayFrames, one column every framesPerStep frames (the next gun locked until it locks into the front slot); after `positions` slides it covers its cannon and stops. One slide from covering a standing cannon, the gun whose fall would cover it pulses every pulseFrames.

hangar._: The doors launch the escort (their flash cueFrames before each) and stop it when they fall. Locked they are barred armour (band.png); the moment they unlock their open look (open.png, amber chevrons) is drawn and they flash, the hit's high tone held unlockFrames frames.
